stage: Conditional manuscript study, after eight calibration keys were recovered; before manuscript fitting
units: greedy cth ckh cph cfh ch sh within original words; remaining individual characters
selection: Complete clean prose lines; entire uncertain or interrupted lines excluded; metadata L/H; all sides/panels of physical folio share SHA256(numeric folio)%3. Fold0 transfer, others fit. First >=3000 fit and >=1000 transfer units in source order, retain whole last line.
prior_exposure: Manuscript corpus and many loci seen in older phases; not a genuinely blind historical reserve. No source readings adjudicated.
key_fit: ZL only; two languages; maxHomophones3; same6restarts250rounds as calibration; no lock or crib
transfer: Same key on ZL reserve and available clean IT counterparts; missing IT loci listed; ? for units not observed in fit, breaks score windows.
null: One order2 Markov stream fitted only to manuscript fit units for each selection; separate fit/transfer seeds; equal lengths and same fixed solver budget. Generated without target plaintext, not a historical origin model. Four draws, not independent across language comparisons. A dead-end state restarts with an observed pair; restart boundaries are not claimed to follow an exact stationary Markov law.
exploratory_screen: Coverage>=0.95, ZL transfer score>=minimum corresponding-language true calibration transfer score, and greater than matched generated transfer score. No inferential p-value. Passing only warrants further checking; never validates semantics.
output: Preserve every key and unsegmented output labeled NOT_TRANSLATION; no English/French paraphrase or inserted lexical words.
